_comment: Reviewed Community source dependencies and supported application/executor build contexts. The legacy Python sandbox image context is excluded; retained sandbox Skill source and Node dependency locks remain inventoried. Runtime image redistribution requires a separate image inventory. See docs/third-party-licenses.en-US.md.

7zip.note: unRAR code carries an additional restriction

docker.note: official docker CLI image on Alpine (system components, including GPL ones, are aggregated as separate programs)

library/node.note: official Node.js image on Debian (system components, including GPL ones, are aggregated as separate programs)

library/python.note: official Python image on Debian (system components, including GPL ones, are aggregated as separate programs)

components.name: Playwright install-deps chromium system libraries
components.note: Chromium runtime libraries (NSS, GTK, X11, fonts, ...) from Playwright's built-in list; package names and licenses change with the Playwright version, verify with dpkg inside the image
